title: Glass Orchard — fruit merge
constraints: no external fonts — system fonts only

workerResult.summary: Glass Orchard — a Suika-style fruit merge inside a single hairline-drawn glass, extreme-minimal: warm bone paper, ink outlines, muted glass-toned fruit orbs with specimen numbers, system fonts only. Aim-and-drop physics (gravity, pairwise circle collisions, squash on impact), chain merges with combo scoring and pop-rings, ghost aim guide + dashed drop line, soft WebAudio blips, game-over cracks when the glass overflows, and a results card. Share copies a score card (clipboard + native share sheet where available), Save exports a 2x PNG of the orchard, best score and games persist in localStorage. Verified in-browser at desktop, 375px, and 320px widths with zero console errors and no horizontal overflow.
